summary:
Oppo’s Family – The Last Message from Mars is an illustrated and animated educational storytelling project created by Kerem and Yağız Taşkın.

Our goal is to introduce NASA’s space exploration robots to children in a fun, understandable, and memorable way.

The story follows Oppo, a friendly character inspired by NASA’s Opportunity rover, who introduces other spacecraft and rovers as members of his imaginary space family. By combining real milestones in space exploration with creative storytelling, we transform complex scientific information into an engaging adventure.

Our project includes an illustrated storybook and an animated demo video narrated by Oppo. Through these materials, we aim to help children recognize important space missions, remember their achievements, and develop curiosity about science and space exploration.

We believe that when scientific discoveries become stories, children can connect with them more easily.

Oppo’s Family – The Last Message from Mars

Created by Kerem and Yağız Taşkın

Oppo’s Family – The Last Message from Mars is an interactive digital storybook that introduces children to the history of space exploration through the adventures of a friendly Mars rover named Oppo.

Inspired by NASA’s Opportunity rover, the story follows Oppo as he introduces his imaginary space family: Sputnik 1, Sojourner, Curiosity, and Perseverance. Each character represents an important milestone in the history of space exploration.

The story combines real scientific achievements with creative storytelling. It explores Opportunity’s remarkable journey on Mars, its search for evidence of ancient water, and the dust storm that brought its mission to an end in 2018.
